name: Pratyusha
description: Dawn ground, and the only place here that is trying to be pleasant. A long low ridge faces the light and the whole near slope is terraced into shallow seats. The seats are grassed over and worn through in the middle of each one.

pois.label: Grassed seat
pois.text: Turf grown over the stone, and a bald patch worn through it exactly where a person would sit. Every seat on the slope has the same bald patch in the same place.

pois.label: Ridge crest
pois.text: From the top the whole slope is below you and facing away. The far side is dark and has nothing built on it and no seats.

pois.label: First-light mark
pois.text: A notch cut into the crest stone, shallow and old. Set behind it and sighted through, it lines up with a gap in the far hills that only exists at one hour.
